data.name: Reginald Sixpence
data.description:
The clockmaker and mechanic of the Marquis's, Reginald has a special connection with all of the mansion's clocks. His watch is what allows Lafcadio to travel back in time, and his special mask ability is what grants Lafcadio the ability to save the game and set his spawn point at any ticking clock.

He is the first guest to die, in the chapel at around 3:45 p.m. Almost everyone in the house hears the shot that kills him, but none of them realize it's a gunshot.

Assassin Outclassin': He manages to knock out his assailant with a thrown candlestick if you can prevent the first shot. Blown Across the Room: He's blasted backwards by the servant's rifle. Clock Punk: His inventions typically have this character. He's also the one who fixes your time-travelling pocketwatch. Failed a Spot Check: After being rescued, he immediately forgets knocking out a homicidal staff member with a candlestick and assumes the prone man on the floor simply sleeping off some drink. Gadgeteer Genius: He designed all the clocks in the Brutale, the robotic card dealer in the casino, and incendiary devices. Small Role, Big Impact: He's the first Guest you save, and before you even get the full stopwatch that lets you play a full day, so you don't get much time to know him. Additionally, since he's in a location far from where you start the game following his tutorial, you won't interact with him nearly as much as with the other guests, who generally mill about more. His death also comes at around 4:00, a third of the way into the day, whereas most of the deaths happen much later, to the point hearing the gunshot across the mansion is something all the staff have to cover for when the guests ask about it. Despite this, he aided the Marquis in his plans to burn down the Casino in the first place and helped with the creation of the timed incendiary bombs. Were it not for his aid and the Marquis' error in timing them, the mansion would have never burned down with the guests still in it and the Marquis wouldn't be so wracked with guilt as to relive and remix the terrible day to the point he has.

Unwitting Instigator of Doom: He was complicit in the Marquis's plan to burn down the Sexy Brutale and start a new life with the insurance money, before it went horribly wrong. You Are Too Late: His realisation of Lucas' mistake with the timers comes too late for him to stop the incendiary devices burning down the mansion with everyone inside.

Reginald Sixpence is a genius clockmaker and mechanic who was originally commissioned to create the extravagant timepieces featured throughout the mansion.

Reginald could be somewhat blind to the intentions and emotions of others, and he has become distraught that some of the Marquis’ projects may have had much darker and more dangerous aims than he could have imagined.

Reginald Sixpence is one of the ten Attendees at The Sexy Brutale which Lafcadio must save from death.

Schedule: 12:00 pm - Appears in a Chapel hallway, frantically pacing back and forth while muttering to himself. 12:35 pm - Walks into another hallway. Seems to be looking for a safe. 12:55 pm - Walks into the room with the safe. He rifles through it, dropping the Blank Cartridge on the ground, before leaving in frustration. 1:35 pm - Enters the Chapel. Walks around it, searching fruitlessly for something, before walking up and behind the altar. Unable to find what he's looking for, he turns to the stained glass window and yells. 3:15 pm - Two Diamonds enters into the room and confronts Sixpence with a shotgun. Sixpence pleads for his life. His pleas are met with deaf ears, as Two Diamonds shoots Sixpence in the chest at 3:45 pm. 3:50 pm - Sixpence's mask burns away, confirming his death.

Occupation: Clockmaker

Mask Power: Time manipulation

Reginald Sixpence is one of the ten Attendees at The Sexy Brutale which Lafcadio must save from death.

Biography Schedule 12:00 pm - Appears in a Chapel hallway, frantically pacing back and forth while muttering to himself.

"Calm down Reggie... They won't look for you here... Probably."

12:35 pm - Walks into another hallway. Seems to be looking for a safe. 12:55 pm - Walks into the room with the safe. He rifles through it, dropping the Blank Cartridge on the ground, before leaving in frustration.

"Who locks garbage in a safe?!"

1:35 pm - Enters the Chapel. Walks around it, searching fruitlessly for something, before walking up and behind the altar. Unable to find what he's looking for, he turns to the stained glass window and yells:

"LUCAS! WHAT HAVE YOU DONE!"

3:15 pm - Two Diamonds enters into the room and confronts Sixpence with a shotgun. Sixpence pleads for his life, saying:

"You don't know what's going to happen!"

His pleas are met with deaf ears, as Two Diamonds shoots Sixpence in the chest at 3:45 pm.

3:50 pm - Sixpence's mask burns away, confirming his death.

Sixpence's death is the first in the game. He is cornered in the Chapel by Two Diamonds holding a shotgun. As he pleads for his life, Two Diamonds shoots him regardless, knocking Sixpence's body back and creating a pool of blood on the floor, and Two Diamonds admits he'll not enjoy cleaning it up.

Sixpence's Mask Power is vital to all stages of the game, allowing the player to set their spawn point in rooms with a wound clock, which makes saving the guests much easier. His Mask Power also allows the player to fast forward through the day when at a wound clock.
